info.name: Vinsky API Documentation
info.description: A RESTful API for managing orchestras, their members, programs, events, and musical scores. It provides structured access control, allowing authenticated users to collaborate within orchestras, organize rehearsals and concerts, and manage shared sheet music through secure file uploads.
